row:
Packerland is a full service veterinary clinic offering routine services as well as advanced diagnostics and orthopedic care to patients not only Green Bay, but all around the state of Wisconsin and Upper Michigan through a great network of referring veterinarians.  
We want to offer helpful pet care tips as well as fun behind the scenes looks at the daily life of a vet clinic.
The tips and information offered is not meant to replace veterinary care for your pet.  Always, if you have questions about your pet's health, visit your veterinarian!
